title: Online Open-World Wafer Defect Discovery using Hyperdimensional Computing
abstract: arXiv:2610.28949v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Conventional wafer defect analysis relies on offline, closed-world classifiers that fail to detect novel, unseen defect signatures emerging during continuous semiconductor manufacturing. To address this, we propose WaferHDC, an online open-world wafer defect discovery framework based on hyperdimensional computing (HDC). The memory-centric architecture of WaferHDC enables rapid anomaly detection and grouping of recurring failures into compact hypervector representations. This allows the memory space to dynamically scale with new defect modes without retraining a static classifier or archiving entire raw wafer history. WaferHDC first models normal spatial distributions, then dynamically groups recurring failures into persistent defect memory without labels or predefined class counts. It outperforms the strongest online baseline by 13.3 p.p. in adjusted Rand index and 10.5 p.p. in normalized mutual information on the industry-standard WM-81

translated_title: 基于超维计算的在线开放世界晶圆缺陷发现
translated_abstract: 传统的晶圆缺陷分析依赖于离线的、封闭世界分类器，无法检测到在连续半导体制造过程中出现的新型、未曾见过的缺陷特征。为解决这一问题，我们提出了WaferHDC，一个基于超维计算（HDC）的在线开放世界晶圆缺陷发现框架。WaferHDC以存储为中心的架构能够实现快速异常检测，并将重复出现的故障分组为紧凑的超向量表示。这使得存储空间能够随着新的缺陷模式动态扩展，而无需重新训练静态分类器或存档完整的原始晶圆历史数据。WaferHDC首先对正常空间分布进行建模，然后在无标签或预定义类别数量的情况下，将重复出现的故障动态分组到持久缺陷存储中。在行业标准WM-81数据集上，该方法在调整兰德指数（adjusted Rand index）方面超越最强的在线基线13.3个百分点，在归一化互信息（normalized mutual information）方面超越10.5个百分点。
tldr: 提出了基于超维计算的在线开放世界晶圆缺陷发现框架WaferHDC，无需标签或重训即可动态发现并分组新型晶圆缺陷模式，在WM-81数据集上调整兰德指数超越最强在线基线13.3个百分点。
en_tdlr: WaferHDC, a hyperdimensional computing-based online open-world framework, dynamically discovers and groups novel wafer defect modes without labels or retraining, outperforming the strongest online baseline by 13.3 p.p. in adjusted Rand index on WM-81.
